_meta.what_this_is: A small curriculum as a prerequisite graph, plus what a learner has already mastered. Each module lists the modules that must be mastered BEFORE it can be fruitfully studied. The ready-to-learn frontier is the set of modules whose prerequisites are all mastered but which the learner has not mastered yet -- the only modules worth recommending now. Study a module whose prerequisites are unmet and the learner bounces off it: the material assumes things they do not have.
_meta.data_is: A FIXTURE. Hand-authored prerequisites and a mastered set so the frontier and the by-order bug's mistake are exact and checkable.
